title: Enterprise Implementation Consultant - WFM, Inventory, Back-Office
description:

This position owns the successful implementation of Fourth ’s Workforce Management and Back Office solutions across hospitality and retail environments.

• Coordinate integrations with payroll, POS, ERP, and related systems

• Support data validation, parallel testing, and user acceptance readiness

• Partner with Project Managers to ensure delivery milestones are met within scope and timeline

• Facilitate customer workshops and training sessions

• Maintain accurate implementation documentation

• Escalate scope, integration, or data risks appropriately

What You Bring

• Experience configuring systems that impact labor, payroll, inventory, or operational workflows

• Exposure to multi-location or enterprise customer environments

• Experience leading customer discovery sessions and facilitating training or workshops

• Ability to manage multiple implementations within defined scope and timelines

• Strong communication and documentation skills

• Clean configuration and validated data prior to go-live

• Clear communication and proactive risk management

• Strong customer adoption at launch

• Adherence to established delivery methodology

Work Environment
This role is remote-eligible within the United States for candidates residing in the following approved states:
AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, and WA.
Candidates must maintain a professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
Travel may be required based on customer needs and implementation scope.
Benefits

Fourth offers:

• Unlimited PTO

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Parental Leave

• Company-provided laptop and equipment

This role provides the opportunity to work in operationally complex environments that directly impact how hospitality and retail organizations manage labor, inventory, and compliance. title: Product Specialist
description:
ICS.AI · Remote (UK)
Full-time, permanent
Salary up to £35,000
Turn ideas, client needs and AI opportunities into products that are clear, buildable and ready to deliver.
ICS.AI is the UK’s market leader in AI solutions for local government, partnering with more than 20 councils to transform public service delivery. Our products span AI contact centres, staff copilots and social care copilots, helping organisations improve resident experiences, increase productivity and deliver smarter services.
We’re looking for a Product Specialist to take ownership of one of our core products. Sitting within the Product team and reporting to the Product Manager, you’ll become the product authority turning client and business needs into validated specifications, a sprint-ready backlog and accurate product documentation.
What you’ll be doing

• Leading the Specify process for core product builds, creating detailed specifications and AI-assisted prototypes.

• Managing and maintaining the backlog for one core product in Azure DevOps.

• Grooming, prioritising and sizing backlog items with the Product Manager so the backlog stays sprint-ready.

• Writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria that support confident development, testing and release.

• Producing and maintaining user guides, release notes, onboarding materials and process documentation.

• Turning feedback from client user groups, AI Champion networks, QBRs and service tickets into structured backlog inputs.

• Contributing to sprint reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement sessions across product lines.

• Supporting go-to-market materials, feature descriptions and release communications.

What makes this role different
This is a hands-on product ownership role at the centre of how ICS.AI specifies and builds AI products. You’ll work closely with Delivery, Technical Leads, Engineering and the Product Manager, using AI-assisted prototyping to move from an identified need to a clear, testable and buildable solution. Your impact will be visible in the quality of the backlog, the clarity of the product documentation and the confidence with which features move into delivery.
What we’re looking for

• Hands-on experience managing an Agile backlog and taking part in sprint ceremonies, typically gained as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a similar technology, AI or software role.

• Strong written communication, with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and specifications.

• Confidence using AI prototyping and requirements tools, including vibe-prototyping platforms.

• A structured, detail-focused approach to documentation and backlog management.

• The ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Knowledge of GenAI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI-including a practical understanding of what AI agents can and cannot do.

• A practical understanding of SaaS or AI product development, release management and versioning.

• Eligibility to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

• Experience as a Product Owner.

• Experience with Azure DevOps Boards or equivalent backlog tooling.

• Hands-on use of AI or vibe-prototyping tools to create working prototypes or specifications.

• Experience of local government or wider public sector service delivery.

• A Product Owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO.

The package

• Salary up to £35,000.

• Full-time, permanent role.

• Remote within the UK, with occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites.

• £100 per month working-from-home allowance.

• Vitality Healthcare Plan.

• Pension scheme.

• 25 days’ holiday.

• Support for relevant professional development and qualifications.

title: Model Validation Senior Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as  personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and  combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰  £85,000 - £105,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits 

⭐Our Model Oversight team

The second line of defence Model Oversight team (that’s us!) provides support to our colleagues in Borrowing, Fincrime & Fraud, Finance and Operations to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for a Model Validation Senior Manager - Gen AI to lead the teams’ oversight of Generative AI models/use cases (primarily built across Monzo’s Operations squads) to provide assurance that the models/use cases we use are not only good for Monzo but what's best for our customers.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

Driving the embedding of the Model Risk Framework for Generative AI use cases across Monzo

• Lead the collaboration with the first line of defence teams to strengthen policies, standards and procedures for Generative AI model, use case, system design and build, implementation, governance, monitoring and use.  Helping to embed best practice of Generative AI across the business. 

• Own the setting and maintenance of Generative AI validation methods, evidence expectations and reusable technical assets with relevant 1LoD modelling teams, applicable across all model risk areas.

• Convert modelling/validation experience into controlled playbooks, tests and working examples that can be applied to 2LoD Validation standards and processes for all Generative AI models, use cases, systems overseen by the 2LoD Model Oversight team.

• Coach Generative AI validation methodologies, to 2LoD Model Oversight colleagues, whom already have transferable Machine Learning skills, to reduce reliance on any single specialist for the validation of Generative AI models, use cases, systems so it can be consistently applied across Financial, Credit and Fincrime/Fraud models. 

Leading the 2LoD Oversight of Operational Model Risk

• Perform, and oversee, independent model validations of new Operational models (primarily Generative AI models, use cases, systems),  and changes to existing, using proportionate modelling techniques depending on the level of complexity applied. This includes writing clear and impactful model validation reports and presenting the findings in relevant committees.

• Build relationships with first line of defence modelling teams that develop Operational Models, and wider risk teams, to support the embedding of the model risk framework to help Monzo grow safely. 

• Review ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure Operational models are performing within risk thresholds and providing support to the relevant model development team when further action is required

• Monitoring and measuring the overall level of Operational model risk that Monzo operates, and driving action plans with first line teams and appropriate governance forums to mitigate residual model risk within desired risk appetite.

Being a senior advocate of Model Risk Management best practices

• Support the effective operation of the Model Risk Oversight Committee as a regular attendee, contributing to the group discussion to improve model risk management.

title: Total Rewards & People Business Partner
description: People Business Partner & Total Rewards Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading. The role This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them. The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it. The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey. title: Chef du Marketing (H/F)
description:
Rejoignez la meilleure compagnie d'évaluation de produits en tant que Chef du Marketing ! C'est votre opportunité d'avoir un réel impact sur la façon dont des millions de personnes découvrent RTINGS.com et interagissent avec notre marque. Votre expertise contribuera à façonner notre croissance, à renforcer notre relation avec nos utilisateurs et à accroître notre présence à l'échelle mondiale.
RTINGS.com bénéficie déjà d'une solide réputation, compte des millions d'utilisateurs et offre un produit auquel les gens font confiance. L'objectif n'est donc pas de bâtir une marque à partir de zéro, mais plutôt de faire évoluer ce que nous avons déjà construit et de l'amener à sa prochaine étape de croissance.
Votre mandat principal
Vous évaluerez la façon dont RTINGS.com se positionne aujourd’hui et déterminerez ce qui doit évoluer au niveau de notre marque, de notre positionnement, de nos messages, de nos relations publiques, de nos médias sociaux, de notre SEO, de nos infolettres et de nos autres canaux organiques.
Vous dirigerez ensuite cette transformation avec pour objectif de faire de RTINGS.com une marque beaucoup plus reconnue à l’échelle mondiale et de créer des relations plus fortes et plus directes avec nos utilisateurs.
Aperçu de ce que nous offrons:

• Rémunération compétitive, basée selon l’expérience et l’expertise du candidat

• Horaire flexible 

• Prestations d’assurance collective payées

• Cotisation REER de l’employeur

• Contribution au remboursement de la condition physique

• Contribution au remboursement de transports

• Programme de référence des employés

• Culture de plaisir et de convivialité

• Diriger la stratégie de marque et de développement de l'audience de RTINGS.com afin d'accroître sa notoriété, sa crédibilité et la demande directe à l'échelle mondiale pour notre laboratoire de tests indépendant

Personnalité

• Vous êtes curieux et aimez apprendre

• Vous aimez être impliqué concrètement (hands on), mettre en place des processus et analyses des données

• Vous êtes motivé, orienté vers les résultats et faites preuve d'un excellent sens de l'organisation

• Vous aimez aider les gens

Qualifications/Expérience

• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en marketing B2C, notamment en image de marque, relations publiques et communications, médias sociaux, SEO ou gestion de l'audience organique

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insight-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. • Build, document, and maintain internal systems, workflows, and filing structures

Healthcare Regulatory Research and Compliance Support

title: GTM Engineer

The Opportunity
At Riverside Insights , we are building the world's highest-performing double bottom line business, one where strong business performance and real impact for learners make each other stronger. Our research-backed assessments help educators and clinicians discover the unique strengths and challenges of each learner, and grow the potential in every student. As we scale in revenue, growth is how that impact reaches more schools, more districts, and more kids.
That is where you come in. As our GTM Engineer, you will build the AI and automation layer behind our go-to-market organization. This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of GTM, AI, and revenue operations. You will design, build, and ship the agents, workflows, and integrations that take manual work off the plates of our sales, marketing, customer success, and GTM Operations teams, and you will put practical AI tools in the hands of everyone who sells and supports our products. Every hour you give back is an hour our people can spend with the students and educators we serve, and a way to reach K-12 districts, schools, and clinical professionals with more precision without growing headcount at the same rate. That is our double bottom line at work: capacity that powers both revenue and mission.
Selling into education has its own rhythm: fiscal-year budget cycles, federal and state funding streams, RFP-driven procurement, buying committees that span superintendents, assessment directors, and school psychologists, and strict expectations for protecting student data. You will build systems tuned to that reality, so our teams show up at the right district, with the right message, at the right point in the buying cycle.
You will be GTM Operations' builder. You will partner with our Revenue Analytics, Systems & RevTech, Deal Operations, and Global Operations owners to find the highest-leverage opportunities, ship in short sprints, measure the hours and revenue impact of every build, and teach the team to use and extend what you create. Enable the team. Coach GTM teammates to use AI and build their own simple automations, backed by a shared prompt and skills library.

Govern AI responsibly. Set standards for monitoring and human review, and ensure every workflow meets FERPA, COPPA, and state student-privacy requirements.

title: Junior Digital Innovation Engineer
description:
The Junior Digital Innovation Engineer supports the R&D team's mandate to explore and prototype emerging AI/ML capabilities, evaluate new technologies, and investigate improved software development approaches. Working under the guidance of the Team Lead and senior team members, the role conducts technology and literature scanning, assists in building proof-of-concept prototypes and feasibility spikes, documents findings clearly, and presents experiment results to the team. The role is expected to grow steadily in independence and technical scope as competence and confidence increase.
Technology & Literature Scanning

• Researches and tracks developments in AI/ML, emerging frameworks, and developer tooling relevant to the product and team's technology stack.

• Summarises findings from articles, papers, vendor releases, and community sources into digestible internal notes.

• Flags technologies, platforms, or techniques (e.g., new LLM capabilities, AI/ML frameworks, cloud AI services) that may warrant a deeper spike.

• Maintains an up-to-date view of the broader industry landscape relevant to the team's exploration areas.

Assisting with Prototypes and Feasibility Spikes

• Assists in building small-scale proofs-of-concept and feasibility spikes under the guidance of the Team Lead or senior team members.

• Implements clearly-scoped experimental tasks using assigned frameworks, APIs, or platforms (e.g., LangChain, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face).

• Sets up and tears down experimental environments in a controlled, low-risk manner.

• Escalates technical blockers or scope uncertainty early rather than stalling on unclear experiments.

Documentation of Findings

• Documents experiment setup, methodology, results, and conclusions clearly for each spike or proof-of-concept.

• Records what worked, what did not, and why, to build the team's shared knowledge base.

• Uses agreed tools (e.g., Confluence, Jira) consistently to track spikes and their outcomes.

• Keeps documentation current as experiments evolve or are re-scoped.

Presenting Experiment Results

• Presents proof-of-concept and spike outcomes to the team in a clear, structured manner.

• Articulates what was tested, the results observed, and a recommendation on next steps (progress, pivot, or shelve).

• Responds to questions from the Team Lead and peers about methodology and findings.

• Builds confidence and clarity in presenting technical material as experience grows.

Ramp-Up and Learning Velocity

• Actively works through onboarding materials, prior spike documentation, and internal knowledge bases.

• Pairs frequently with the Team Lead and senior team members to build understanding of the innovation pipeline and evaluation framework.

• Builds proficiency with the team's core AI/ML tools, frameworks, and experimentation practices.

• Tracks own learning goals and progress with support from a mentor or the Team Lead.

Adherence to Experimentation Standards

• Follows the team's defined spike/experiment process, tracking conventions, and documentation standards.

• Uses agreed tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git) consistently and correctly for tracking spikes.

• Applies data-handling, security, and ethical-use guidelines when experimenting with AI/ML tools and third-party platforms.

• Applies feedback from Team Lead and senior reviewers consistently in subsequent spikes.

Continuous Improvement and Feedback

• Attends and engages in team retrospectives and knowledge-sharing sessions, offering observations even as a newer team member.

• Acts on constructive feedback from the Team Lead and senior reviewers.

• Reflects on own experiment outcomes and demonstrates visible improvement in technical judgement over time.

• Builds toward taking on progressively larger and less-supervised exploration work.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR a completed coding bootcamp / equival

Denk aan klanten in de high-tech, logistiek en maakindustrie die vertrouwen op jouw expertise voor hun logistieke succes. Bij SUPERP maak je écht impact, samen met een team van vakidioten dat verder kijkt dan cijfers alleen.
Over SUPERP

SUPERP is een IT-consultancy partner die sinds 1999 het digitale hart van toonaangevende organisaties versterkt. Met meer dan 500 consultants bouwen we aan betrouwbare, toekomstbestendige Digital Core-systemen. We combineren de slagkracht van een grote speler met de betrokkenheid van een specialist. Onze expertise in SAP, Mendix, Salesforce, Microsoft en gebieden als AI, security, analytics, development, integratie en quality assurance zorgt voor slimme, flexibele IT-oplossingen. Bij SUPERP werken echte vakidioten met passie voor hun werk. Mensen die complexe IT-vraagstukken door en door snappen én oplossen. Nuchter, betrokken en recht door zee. We denken mee, zeggen waar het op staat en doen wat werkt.
Functieomschrijving
Als SAP Supply Chain Consultant maak je deel uit van ons SAP Core-team. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende specialismen en voert opdrachten uit bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Je taken omvatten onder andere:

• Het leiden van workshops om logistieke processen helder in kaart te brengen.

• Adviseren over technische oplossingen, architectuur en innovatie.

• Realiseren van end-to-end oplossingen voor uitdagingen zoals S/4HANA (RISE of GROW) transities, cloudmigraties en procesoptimalisatie.

Dankzij onze brede expertise vertrouwen klanten op SUPERP voor oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen jouw eigen domein. Dit betekent dat je meedenkt op strategisch niveau en écht impact maakt.
Requirements
Wat breng je mee?

• Gedegen kennis van SAP SCM (Sourcing & Procurement, Inventory Management & Warehouse Management, Transportation Management).

• Een logistieke achtergrond (HBO werk- en denkniveau, eventueel aangevuld met APICS of NEVI I/II).

• Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kunnen moeiteloos sparren met logistiek en inkoopafdelingen.

• De drive om niet alleen hands-on te werken, maar ook workshops te leiden en klanten te adviseren.

Wat bieden wij jou?
Bij SUPERP geef jij richting aan je eigen carrière. Wij ondersteunen, stimuleren en faciliteren jouw ontwikkeling, zonder vastomlijnde functiehuizen. Wat je verder kunt verwachten:

• Salaris: tot € 6.500,- per maand (senior), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

• Winstdeling: jouw bijdrage wordt beloond met een bonus die kan oplopen tot meerdere maandsalarissen.

• Flexibele mobiliteit: kies tussen een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

• Vakantiedagen: 25 dagen per jaar.

• Persoonlijke groei: toegang tot de nieuwste technologieën en trainingen.

Proces
In twee gesprekken maak je kennis met je toekomstige teamleider, een salescollega en een teamgenoot. Heb je specifieke wensen over wie je wilt spreken? Laat het ons weten, dan maken we dat mogelijk!
Enthousiast geworden? Mooi!
Solliciteren kan heel eenvoudig via het formulier hieronder. Ook als je eerst nog wat meer wilt weten over de functie of over werken SUPERP , kun je hier je gegevens achterlaten. Thijs Cornet neemt dan snel contact met je op om je vragen te beantwoorden of je meer te vertellen over ons sollicitatieproces. Je kan uiteraard altijd contact opnemen via of 030 303 9400

title: Solutions Architect
description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

About The Role

You design how the Sunrise robotic cell fits into a customer's production line. You take a manual process and turn it into a safe, efficient, fully automated robotic cell: you map the process, model the cell in simulation, lay out the floor, prove the cycle time, and define the safety concept.

You sit in Product, on the Solutions team, at the border between a customer's technical strategy and our own product. You own the technical concept behind each proposal, and what you learn from customers feeds directly into where the product goes next.

Winning the deal is the start, not the finish. The fast concept that wins a proposal then has to be refined into a full application design before anything gets built. That design work is the core of the role, and it is where most of your effort goes.

What You'll Do

- Analyze a customer's existing manufacturing process and propose and design a safe, efficient, fully automated solution.

- Model the robotic cell in simulation to validate reachability, find bottlenecks, and prove feasibility.

- Design the placement, footprint, and material flow of the cell from customer data.

- Calculate cycle times, Takt time, and the throughput we can guarantee from real production data.

- Own the technical concept behind each proposal, then refine the winning concept into a complete application design.

- Present the concept, layout, and throughput case to the customer, and fold their feedback into the design.

- Act as the technical voice of Sunrise in customer calls.

- Hand finalized process maps, simulations, and layouts to our internal Deployment team.

- Gather raw data, floor plans, and production requirements directly from customer engineering teams.

- Feed what you learn in the field back into product direction.

What You'll Need

- 5 or more years in automation engineering, robotics integration, or solutions design for manufacturing.

- Strong proficiency in robotic simulation software, such as Process Simulate, Visual Components or similar.

- Solid CAD experience, such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD or similar, for layout and 3D data.

- Proven cycle-time calculation, capacity planning, and manufacturing-data analysis.

- A deep understanding of material flow, lean manufacturing, and process sequencing.

- Clear communication, including presenting technical concepts and layouts directly to customers.

- A base in a CET +/- 3 time zone and eligibility to travel within the Schengen area.

What Makes You Stand Out

- Knowledge of robotic safety standards, such as EN ISO 10218.

- Experience with diverse manufacturing data formats and KPIs.

- Familiarity with gripping technologies, feeding systems, and conveyor integration.

- Exposure to a range of manufacturing environments and production processes.

- Experience with Isaac Sim.

Why Us?

You join as the Solutions team forms, with the scope to shape how Sunrise turns customer problems into robotic cells.

- Direct impact: when a customer's line hits its throughput target on a cell you designed, that is your work.

- Real constraints, not slideware

We build the systems that decide how customers get help from the moment they describe their problem to the moment it’s resolved. This role will help shape how Support Services, RevOps, GTM, and core Engineering teams collaborate on customers. This is not a tools team. About a third of our work directly supports the support organization. You’ll design and build the systems that sit between ClickHouse’s customers and the teams who serve them. The work is varied by design, and you’ll move between problem types as priorities shift:

- Intelligent routing and decision systems. Software that decides where work should go and who should handle it, weighing many signals at once, and is built to adapt as the business scales.

- AI-powered customer experiences. Customer-facing and internal experiences that understand what someone needs, recommend the best next step, and know when to hand off to a human.

- Integrations and data flow. Connections across Salesforce, live chat, incident management, Slack, GitHub, and more, so workflows and data move cleanly between systems.

- Automation and observability. Systems that remove repetitive work, surface what’s breaking, and give teams confidence in what they’re running.

Across all of it, you’ll partner with core Engineering to ship to production, and own what you build: code review, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

ВИКЛИКИ, ЯКІ ЧЕКАЮТЬ НА ЦІЙ РОЛІ

- Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

- Масштабувати креативи, що показали результат, і створювати частину креативів самостійно за допомогою автоматизації і шаблонів.

ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

- 2+ роки досвіду у перформанс-маркетингу, зокрема повний цикл роботи з дизайнером - від постановки ТЗ і запуску до відповідальності за результат.

- Буде плюсом: базові навички Figma / Adobe, робота з рекламними кабінетами Meta / Google, англійська для написання текстовок.

ЩО ТИ ОТРИМАЄШ ДОДАТКОВО РАЗОМ З НАМИ

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: аналітика, продукт, маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і рекрутинг.

title: Oncology Nurse Navigator
description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief
Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.
Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
The “Nurse Navigator” Role
Our oncology nurse navigators are the front-line of CancerNavigator ’s patient service. Nurse Navigators support patients at all parts of their journey - newly diagnosed, in active treatment, and entering remission. With more specificity, oncology nurse navigators:

• Educate cancer patients (and their families) about their diagnosis, treatment options, and provide helpful information on any related questions and concerns the patient may have

• Work closely with the researchers on our team to deliver tailored information to patients, guiding them to the centers and doctors that would be a great option for the patient’s care

• Do everything possible to address any barriers to care (e.g. registering and scheduling appointments, coordinating with their health plan or their care team, transferring records, etc.)

• Provide longitudinal support to the patient throughout their journey - helping them solve any issues related to their cancer diagnosis and care - whether connecting patients to mental health support, finding resources to ease the financial burden, arranging transportation to appointments, or answering any questions that may arise

The Requirements
The main requirement of this role is oncology nursing experience and a passion for serving cancer patients. More specifically, we are looking for someone with the following experience and qualifications:

• Ability to work Eastern hours (8am-5pm EST)

• 3+ years of oncology nursing experience

• Mastery of common navigation and care coordination issues (registration, scheduling, clinical department navigation, insurance coordination, solving coverage issues, etc.)

• Mastery of basic computer tools (Gmail, Zoom, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Preferred: Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN)

Compensation and Benefits

• Starting Salary Range: $100-115k (based on skills and experience)

• Dental and Healthcare (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

• Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy up coverage)

• Unlimited PTO

• Remote-first work; live where you want within the region

• All-company on-sites 2-3x per year (in Washington DC & Denver)

Our Culture & Values, In Brief
We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer - serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.
We have three company values, which guide our work:

•
Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.

•
Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.

•
Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

title: CAD Drafter
description:
Drafter / Takeoff Specialist - Commercial Roofing, Cladding & Architectural Sheet Metal
Role Overview
We are looking for detail-oriented Drafters to produce shop drawings and material takeoffs for commercial roofing, cladding and architectural sheet metal projects. Your takeoffs jump-start procurement so Project Managers can review, finalize and release material orders months before field measurements are available. We welcome candidates with experience in roofing, cladding, or sheet metal, or any combination of these. Candidates will be matched to project types based on their background.
Workflow

• Project is awarded and handed off from estimating to the PM.

• Drafter prepares shop drawings and completes the initial material takeoff from the same set, working primarily from contract/architectural drawings (DWG/PDF).

• Takeoff is reviewed with the team; Project Managers review and finalize before any order is placed.

• Takeoff/cut list is delivered to the PM as an organized Excel sheet (plus Autodesk layout exports where useful) so materials can be released to external suppliers.

• Turnaround is set per task and project scope. Tasks can range from a few hours to multi-week drawing sets.

Key Responsibilities

• Takeoffs: Perform quantity takeoffs from architectural and engineering drawings. Roofing: square footage, membrane (e.g., TPO/PVC), insulation board counts, fasteners, edge metal, flashing. Cladding and sheet metal: panel counts and lengths, clips, trims, flashing, coping, master-sheet optimization for ACM/MCM, and linear footage for field roll-forming.

• Cut lists & orders: Build supplier-ready cut lists and order data in Excel or via Autodesk export, following the templates and examples provided.

• Shop drawings: Produce shop drawings, roof plans, panel layouts, elevations and details in AutoCAD; mark up in Bluebeam.

• Review & release: Walk takeoffs through with the team, incorporate PM feedback, and release materials once finalized.

• Quality: Verify quantities against drawings, engineering, manufacturer specifications and local codes before release.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: Drafting experience is the core requirement. An experienced superintendent / senior superintendent who has installed systems and done their own takeoffs is also a strong fit.

• Industry knowledge: Experience in commercial roofing, cladding, or architectural sheet metal (one or more) is preferred but not required. Experience in both roofing and cladding/sheet metal is a plus. Must read architectural drawings and understand material limitations (e.g., trims, panel widths, sheet optimization).

• Technical skills: Proficiency in Autodesk/AutoCAD (team uses 2025) and Bluebeam (or Adobe Acrobat Pro); strong Excel skills.

• Core attributes: High attention to detail, accuracy under deadlines, and ability to manage multiple projects at once.

• Communication: Clear written and verbal English for working with Project Managers and the wider team.

Tools, Equipment & Device Requirements

• Software seats: A license/seat will be provided for every program required for the role (e.g., Autodesk/AutoCAD, Bluebeam).

• Own device: If working on a personal computer, it must be able to run AutoCAD and Bluebeam reliably. Devices will be checked against the specifications below during screening.

• Monitors & accessories: Candidates must provide their own dual-monitor setup and associated accessories (keyboard, mouse, headset with microphone, webcam, cables/docking).

Schedule & Work Arrangement

• Employment type: Full Time

• Days: Monday through Friday

• Working hours: US business hours, Central Time (9:00 AM-5:00 PM CT; 8:00 AM-4:00 PM CT also acceptable)

• Location: Fully Remote

Benefits of Working for Hyre

• Performance-based raises.

• Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

• Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

• Opportunities for continuous career growth.

title: VIP Growth Manager (VIP增长经理)
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The VIP Growth Manager will serve as a central strategy and operations partner for the VIP business. Through data analysis, user insights, and cross-functional collaboration, this role will support VIP Relationship Managers and regional teams with growth strategies and initiatives.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical thinking and communication skills, with the ability to identify growth opportunities from user behavior and business data, translate insights into actionable plans, and collaborate with relevant teams to drive execution and continuous optimization.

 

VIP增长经理将作为VIP业务的核心策略与运营伙伴，通过数据分析、用户洞察及跨部门协作，为VIP客户关系经理（RM）及各区域团队提供增长策略与项目支持。

我们希望候选人具备较强的分析思维和沟通能力，能够从用户行为及业务数据中识别增长机会，将洞察转化为可执行的业务方案，并协同相关团队推动落地和持续优化。

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing

Business Insights & Strategy

•
Identify structural problems and opportunities in the data, such as churn signals among high-value users, differences in service needs across client segments, and the marginal return on resource allocation, and turn them into actionable strategies.

•
Write business insight reports for senior management that shape VIP benefits, resource allocation, and team playbooks.

Data Monitoring

•
Build and maintain the VIP core metrics framework with daily monitoring; when a metric moves unexpectedly, find the root cause and recommend actionable next steps.

•
Automate recurring analyses and reports as dashboards or scheduled jobs (for example weekly and monthly reports, incentive plan results, and anomaly alerts) to reduce repetitive manual data pulls.

•
Work with the Data Warehouse and BI teams to standardize metric definitions and build data tables, so the data stays accurate and traceable.

Incentive Plan Design & Execution

•
Design and strategise incentive plans for VIP business teams, covering metric selection, target breakdown, weighting, and payout linkage.

•
Track how the incentive plans are carried out, deliver results weekly and monthly, and update the plan criteria as the business changes (for example VIP tier threshold adjustments or new market launches).

Middle Office Capability Building & Cross-functional Collaboration

•
Document SOPs, metric definitions, and methods for VIP growth, and drive alignment and reuse across regions.

•
Act as the middle office hub between RM teams, regional markets, Product, Risk, and Finance, taking strategies through its entire lifecycle.

•
Gather feedback from frontline teams and users, combine it with business data to find common needs, and help improve the product experience, service processes, and operating tools.

业务洞察与策略制定

•
从数据中识别结构性问题及业务机会，例如高价值用户的流失信号、不同客户群体的服务需求差异，以及资源投入的边际回报等，并将分析结果转化为可执行的业务策略。

•
面向管理层撰写业务洞察报告，为VIP权益设计、资源配置及团队业务打法提供决策依据。

数据监控与分析

•
搭建并持续维护VIP业务核心指标体系，进行日常数据监控；针对指标异常波动及时定位根因，并提出明确、可执行的后续建议。

•
将周期性分析及报告自动化，通过数据看板或定时任务完成周报、月报、激励方案结果分析及异常预警等工作，减少重复性人工取数。

•
与数据仓库及商业智能团队协作，统一指标定义并建设相关数据表，确保数据准确、口径一致且全程可追溯。

激励方案设计与落地

•
负责VIP业务团队激励方案的设计与策略制定，包括指标选择、目标拆解、权重设置及激励结果挂钩机制。

•
跟踪激励方案的执行情况，按周、按月输出结果，并结合业务变化持续调整方案标准，例如VIP等级门槛调整或新市场上线等。

中台能力建设与跨部门协作

•

description:
About the team

Plaid’s Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team enables the business by proactively managing information security risk and maintaining effective controls. We partner across the company to keep Plaid’s platform secure, resilient, and aligned with industry and regulatory expectations.

Our assurance program builds trust with customers, consumers, and data partners. Core compliance is how we prove it. We run the certifications, audits, and regulatory obligations that let banks, customers, and regulators rely on Plaid, and we keep them aligned with a product that keeps changing.

About the role

As Security Compliance Lead, you’ll be the single accountable owner of Plaid’s core security compliance program: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and their governance obligations. Banks, enterprise customers, and regulators rely on what you own when they decide to work with Plaid, and your work keeps those certifications and commitments reliable and on time as the business grows.

You will set the program’s structure and direction, with a roadmap and KPIs that turn compliance from a pass/fail event into a program leadership can steer. The control catalog you build will sit behind every audit, so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy many obligations, from SOC 2 to FedRAMP. Your internal audits will find gaps before an external auditor, customer, or regulator does. You will make sure compliance shapes product decisions before launch instead of reacting to them.

As Plaid expands into new products, markets, and frameworks, you will build a program that keeps pace without adding headcount, using AI and automation.

- Embed GRC by design: Track product roadmaps and supporting infrastructure with Product and Engineering. You will assess how launches and material changes affect audit scope and system boundaries, and build lightweight checkpoints into product discovery.

- Scale through AI and automation: Build repeatable processes, runbooks, and AI-driven automation for evidence, testing, scoping, and audit requests.

- Has been the accountable owner of SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001/27701 programs through multiple audit cycles, including setting the roadmap and KPIs that matured them

title: Sr Talent Partner
description:
About Us
We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are.
What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly.
If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk.
Why this role exists
Most companies fill their first recruiting seat with someone who runs a process. We're not doing that. We've hired recruiters before who could source and coordinate but couldn't tell us who was actually good. We ended up doing the real evaluation ourselves every time, which meant the hire added activity, not leverage. This role is built to fix that specifically: we're hiring for judgment first, process second.
You'll own full-cycle recruiting across every function starting day one, and you'll build the operating system: sourcing, interview loops, scorecards. But the actual bar is narrower and harder than "can you run a process": can we trust your read on a candidate enough to act on it without redoing the work ourselves?
What you'll own

• Full-cycle recruiting (sourcing, evaluation, closing) across GTM, engineering/product, and ops.

• The recruiting operating system: ATS, interview structure, scorecards, sourcing channels, built from scratch, not inherited.

• Direct partnership with the CEO/COO and hiring managers on role scoping and hiring bar: you help set the bar, not just fill against it.

• Hiring metrics that actually inform decisions (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, quality of hire), not vanity throughput numbers.

• Candidate experience and employer brand: often a candidate's first real signal of what working here is like.

What we're testing for

• Independent, evidence-based candidate judgment. As part of the process, you'll evaluate real, anonymized candidate profiles from our own hiring history, and we'll compare your read to what actually happened. This is the single most important thing we're screening for, more than years of experience or past titles.

• Sourcing alpha. Knowing what circles the best candidates swim in and generating conversations with great people who might be least likely to apply through LinkedIn.

• Full-cycle recruiting experience at an early-stage or fast-growing company, ideally as a founding or very early recruiting hire.

• Intelligence and clarity of thinking. During the calibration phase, for example, we're asking if you can contribute to the discovery of the ideal candidate profile.

• Range across functions: equally comfortable evaluating a growth hire and an engineer in the same week.

• A track record of delivering results and taking end-to-end responsibility for them, not just operating inside someone else's system.

• Comfort with ambiguity and founder-speed decision-making. There's no recruiting manager above you, just the CEO and COO.

Nice to have

• Recruiting experience in high growth, hardware, or consumer software subscription environments.

• Employer branding or content chops: job posts and outreach that actually convert.

• Prior experience leading or managing a recruiting team. We're growing quickly, and this role has a real path to building and leading a team, not just staying an individual contributor indefinitely.

The opportunity
This is a founding seat, not a fill-the-req seat. Whoever takes this defines how the company hires for years: the bar, the process, the tools, the brand. You'll start as an IC, closing key gaps yourself, but as we scale, there's a genuine opportunity to build and lead the recru

description:
Principal Data Scientist, AI (Architect-Level Scope)
About KLDiscovery

KLDiscovery is a global eDiscovery and legal technology provider serving large law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies. We build and operate the products and services that legal teams rely on to manage, process, and review case data at scale. With operations across multiple countries and a client base that includes AmLaw 200 firms, we handle some of the largest and most complex matters in the industry.
About the Role
We're hiring our most senior AI practitioner - someone with genuine data science rigor who also wants to build. In this role, you'll set the scientific and architectural direction for gen AI and ML at KLDiscovery : designing the evaluation methodology that proves our AI holds up under legal scrutiny, choosing and validating the models and retrieval systems that power our products, and building the hardest parts of that system yourself.
This is one of the most interesting data science problem sets in enterprise software. You'll work with terabytes of real-world legal data - emails, contracts, chat transcripts, images, video, depositions, and regulatory filings - from some of the largest litigation and investigation matters in the world. The work is hard in ways that matter: documents are messy and adversarial, the stakes are real (privilege, defensibility, attorney work product), and getting the evaluation wrong has real consequences. AI that can surface key people, themes, and timelines in hours instead of weeks, or pre-classify millions of documents for relevance and privilege with results that survive scrutiny, directly changes the economics of how legal matters get resolved. We build solutions that turn data into evidence the legal system can trust.
This is a builder-first role, not a research-only or advisory one. You'll design experiments and evaluation frameworks that prove our AI is defensible in court, build the retrieval and agent systems that reason over case data, and personally ship the hardest, most novel parts of that system. You'll set strategic direction across Nebula, our eDiscovery platform, and CS & Operations, then prove out the science and the architecture by building it yourself. Not a role for anyone stepping back from the keyboard, and not a role for anyone who treats evaluation as an afterthought.
We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, equity, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $190,000 to $240,000.
Job location: Remote (candidate must be based in the United States)
Key Responsibilities
Own the science and the architecture, and build both personally. Design the experimentation and evaluation methodology that determines whether our AI's outputs are accurate, consistent, and defensible - then define the end-to-end gen AI architecture across Nebula and CS & Operations to deliver on it: LLMs, agent harnesses, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and model selection and triage. Build the hardest parts personally: prototype agent loops, design and run the evaluations that validate them, tune retrieval, and ship the shared infrastructure that powers AI Case Explorer (case overviews, timelines, key people and themes, PII surfacing, and Agent chat), AI Agent Review (pre-classifying relevance, privilege, and key issues, shipping MLP), and CS & Ops tech-enablement as part of our central work orchestration system.
Own evaluation rigor, AI/MLOps, and telemetry end-to-end. Design the statistical and experimental methodology behind our evaluation harnesses - the standard our outputs have to meet to hold up under legal scrutiny - and own the infrastructure that enforces it: model deployment

title: Lead Software Development Engineer
description:
About Amperity -Why This, Why Now
Most customer data is a lie by omission.
Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap-between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true-is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.
With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being-in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands-like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running-trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.
Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company-not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. title: BIM Designer & Coordinator: Civil
description:
About the Team

Industrial Compute develops the infrastructure that powers OpenAI’s AI systems. Our Design organization connects engineering, construction, and digital delivery to support complex data center campuses from initial planning through deployment.

Working with internal teams, design consultants, and construction partners, we develop coordinated designs that address site constraints, infrastructure requirements, and future growth. Our BIM team provides the models and workflows needed to deliver consistently across the portfolio.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Civil BIM Designer & Coordinator with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience to support the planning and design of large-scale, mission-critical data center campuses and associated power generation, energy storage, and utility facilities.

In this role, you will develop, coordinate, and maintain civil models using Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Your scope will include site layouts, grading, drainage, roads, and utilities, coordinating buildings with generating equipment, battery energy storage systems (BESS), water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, substations, and cooling systems.

You will work closely with civil engineers, BIM team, discipline designers, equipment vendors, and delivery partners to turn engineering requirements into clear models and deliverables. Your work will support early design reviews, resolve site coordination challenges, and establish repeatable civil BIM practices across concurrent projects. Detailed engineering requirements and specialist analyses will be provided by the responsible engineers.

We are looking for a hands-on civil specialist who can independently manage modeling assignments, communicate design dependencies, and maintain quality as projects evolve.

Key Responsibilities

- Advance feasibility, constructability, and phasing: Prepare layout, grading, routing, and earthwork options for early design reviews; incorporate noise, exhaust dispersion, heat-rejection, safety, and environmental constraints. Model heavy-equipment delivery routes, turning movements, crane areas, laydown, maintenance clearances, staged construction, temporary-to-permanent generation transitions, and future expansion.

- Lead civil site development: Create and maintain surfaces, grading and earthwork models, equipment and building pads, roads, alignments, profiles, and corridors. Incorporate flood protection, stormwater management, and containment or separation process-drainage requirements.

- Develop and coordinate plant utility systems: Model gravity and pressure networks for gas supply, cooling and process water, fire water, wastewater, electrical duct banks, and communications. Coordinate utility models, routes, corridors, crossings, connections, and clearances with engineers, consultants, utility providers, vendors, and construction partners.

- Integrate campus and power-generation infrastructure: Coordinate civil models with buildings, power plants, BESS, substations, water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, cooling systems, and other site utilities. Support simple-cycle and combined-cycle gas turbine, reciprocating engine, and CHP layouts while incorporating equipment separation, service access, and fire access.

- Coordinate equipment, foundation, and thermal interfaces: Integrate vendor general arrangements, foundation footprints, equipment elevations, trenches, pits, and pipe-support locations with inputs from structural, geotechnical, mechanical, and electrical engineers. Coordinate civil interfaces for heat-recovery steam generators, steam-turbine facilities, heat exchangers, cooling towers, air-cooled condensers, radiator arrays, and thermal-distribution corridors.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Marketplace
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

MARKETPLACE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

- Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

- Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

- Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

- A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Product Analyst, Marketplace at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

- Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

- Can trace why drivers or couriers stop bookin

About CrelioHealth

CrelioHealth builds cloud-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow - from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory - for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct-to-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.
The Role
When a lab signs with CrelioHealth , you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.
This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location - and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.
What You Will DoOwn implementations

• Lead onboarding projects for new US clients - single-site labs through multi-location networks - from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.

• Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training - roughly 25-40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.

Make clients successful

• Train lab staff on real workflows - accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal - and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.

• Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.

• Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.

Champion the platform

• Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently - to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.

• Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team - with incentives for you when they close.

• Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

What We Are Looking For (Must-haves)

4-7 years of project management experience , with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.

•
Healthcare experience is required ; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred - as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).

Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. The largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar - it's whether admins, legal teams, and programme owners can actually stay in control.

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to own that layer end-to-end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.

- Audit log experiences that make compliance auditable - not just for the system, but for the humans who need to understand what happened.

- Workspace setup and identity workflows that integrate with real enterprise infrastructure (SSO, SCIM, MCP).

- Analytics and reporting that tell admins whether their deployment is working as intended.

- Set a design vision for our Enterprise surface and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent. As things scale across SSO, compliance, analytics, and billing, you're keeping the mental model consistent.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU BRING:

- Significant experience designing complex, large-scale product surfaces - ideally admin dashboards, governance layers, analytics platforms, or other domains where system thinking matters.

- Technical fluency. You understand APIs, integrations, how services communicate, how widgets and developer hubs work. You can read a technical architecture doc and understand the constraints it creates for design. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.

- Systems thinking: not just about interaction flows, but about enterprise systems. You understand how identity systems, compliance regimes, and scale constraints shape what's actually possible in the UX. Y

title: Capital Markets Partnerships Lead
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Capital Markets Partnerships Lead to build the partner network that allows our clients to access the financing they need to grow their businesses without leaving the Rho platform.

Your accountability in one sentence: build and manage the relationships with firms that can lend to the strategic segments Rho serves, so Rho offers lending through partners. Done right, your work wins deals against competitors that lack these capabilities and retains scaling clients who need venture debt.

This is a build-from-zero seat on the Partnerships team. You'll report to our Head of Partnerships and work daily with Sales, Post-Sales, and Product. We're in-office in New York City or San Francisco.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build the lender partner network across our starting segments: capital-intensive industries, government-contract-oriented industries, and CPG and small-business lending - plus venture debt for scaling clients.

- Source, evaluate, and sign lending partners, then own those relationships ongoing - the signature is the start, not the win.

- Stand up the deal-routing motion: move inbound lending demand out of ad-hoc post-sales handling into a structured referral flow with clear owners in Sales and post-sales.

- Bring partner lending capability into live deals where it wins competitive business or retains a scaling client.

- Lay the groundwork for fund banking lending downstream as the network matures.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Deep lending fluency - you know how lenders evaluate, price, and structure credit - ideally built at a platform lending to startups (venture debt). Domain background is strongly preferred, not a hard requirement: we would also consider an exceptional generalist with strong adjacent lending experience and clear evidence they ramp fast.

- Ideally, partnerships experience at a fintech lending marketplace or similar: you've sourced, signed, and managed lending partners yourself.

- Credible in front of both lenders and clients in our target segments - defense and government-contract, capital-intensive, and CPG/SMB.

- A zero-to-one operator: you turn scattered inbound into a structured motion with routing, owners, and metrics.

- You already use AI to move faster - research, drafting, partner pipeline hygiene - and you're curious what's next.

- Based in New York City or San Francisco and excited to work in office with the team.

NICE TO HAVE

- Existing relationships with venture debt funds and specialty lenders (government-contract, asset-based, or CPG-focused).

- Experience structuring referral or revenue-share partnerships in a regulated environment.

The budgeted total cash compensation for this role (base plus variable, targeted at an 80/20 split) carries a midpoint of approximately $203,000, with a top of band of $238,000. Compensation may vary depending on relevant experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to cash compensation, Rho offers equity, healthcare benefits and paid time off.

Diversity is a core value at Rho. We're passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable environment for all those involved with our mission, including employees, contractors, candidates, customers and vendors. We believe every member of the Rho community enriches our ability to provide a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the market, identify problems, and drive solutions that align with our mission. We welcome all qualified applications and support each of our Rho'ers with ongoing professional growth opportunities.

- Verify the safety software at unit and integration level with automated tests including fault and robustness cases, structural coverage, static analysis, and code and requirement reviews

- You bring specialized expertise and cross-functional knowledge, and solve complex problems with strong analytical and contextual judgment.

title: Landing page & Onboarding Conversion Specialist (Dating, Visa, & Travel)
description:
Landing page & Onboarding Conversion Specialist (Dating, Visa, & Travel)

• Can you spot the weak parts in a funnel and come up with tests to fix them?

• Can you use any CRM or split testing tool successfully by tinkering around for a few hours?

• Can you set up your own tests, including everything from creating the copy, changing the layout, and configuring the javascript tags?

• Are you fluent enough in funnel analytics so you can diagnose WHERE users drop off and WHY, not just report that they did?

• Can you ship 3-5 tests per week in different funnels without breaking things, and read the data cleanly enough to call a winner?

• Do you have experience with Manychat, WhatsApp, Phone Calls, email, etc, as parts of onboarding flows?

• Can you set up or coordinate with ad teams to introduce and optimize remarketing flows on external ad networks?

• Can you quickly and accurately figure out which ads are profitable once you get access to raw data from different sources?

Position Overview:
The Marketing Specialist for New User Onboarding & Lifecycle focuses on increasing revenue and profitability across Together Light Inc .'s dating, visa, and travel business units. This role is primarily focused on optimizing the complete new user journey, from the first touch to full activation. To some extent, the role may be involved with re-engaging past users and testing ad platform content for congruence and conversion.
Your main area:

• Initial Onboarding Flow: Owning the user's experience from the moment they submit an email/phone number.

• Landing Page Optimization: Constant A/B testing and refining all lead capture and remarketing landing pages to maximize conversion.

• First 5-Minutes: Analyzing and improving the first few pages and first few minutes of the new user interface (UI) to drive immediate engagement and activation.

• Reboarding & Remarketing: Creating and managing flows to re-activate dormant users and convert leads from remarketing campaigns.

Examples of Typical Responsibilities (in no particular order):
Landing Page & UI Optimization:

• Develop/test new Call-to-Action (CTA) on new user landing pages.

• Run split tests on UI elements, copy, and page flows for the initial "member's area" experience to reduce drop-off.

• Create and manage continual champion/challenger testing for remarketing landing pages to win back past users.

Onboarding Flow Optimization:

• Take complete ownership of the email, SMS, and push notification sequences for the first 7 days of a new user's life.

• Map, analyze, and optimize the user's journey through the first few pages of the desktop and mobile app interfaces.

• Create and test resource guides, how-to videos, and FAQs specifically designed to be delivered during the initial onboarding period.

Reboarding & Re-engagement:

• Design and implement "reboarding" email and SMS flows for users who sign up but do not activate.

• Develop targeted campaigns for past users or leads, coordinating with internal teams to drive re-engagement.

Analytics & Strategy:

• Debug all flows (links, grammar, load times) to ensure a seamless user experience.

• Prepare reports and track KPIs specifically related to onboarding conversion rates, user activation, and re-engagement success.

• Experiment with alternate versions of offers (e.g., alternate pricing, trial memberships, new VSLs) targeted at new and re-engaging users.

• Propose, implement, and analyze results from continual A/B split testing on all funnels.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Developer Platform
description:
About MoonPay
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.
This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.
AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.
You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.
The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

About the Opportunity
MoonPay is building a developer platform that allows partners to create native payment and crypto experiences directly inside their own products.
Historically, partners integrated MoonPay through a hosted widget and redirected users into a fixed MoonPay journey. We are now breaking the underlying system into reusable modules covering authentication, identity, KYC, quotes, payment methods and purchasing.
These capabilities are exposed through APIs, SDKs, embedded components, iframes and web views. Our goal is for a partner developer to integrate MoonPay’s full capabilities without needing ongoing implementation support from our team.
This role owns the developer-facing layer between MoonPay’s underlying payments infrastructure and the products our partners build. You will work across browsers, mobile applications and backend APIs to make complex financial workflows feel simple, predictable and native.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will build the platform itself rather than implementing one-off integrations for individual customers.
Build the developer platform
Design and build APIs, SDKs and embedded components used by external developers.
Turn MoonPay’s existing authentication, identity, payment and purchasing capabilities into reusable platform modules.
Develop secure browser and mobile integration patterns across iframes, web views and native applications.
Create stable abstractions over complex payments, compliance and crypto infrastructure.
Build reference applications, sandboxes and tooling that help developers move quickly from exploration to production.
Understand the integration deeply
Own the complete developer journey, from obtaining credentials through to completing a live transaction.
Design clear interfaces for sessions, authentication, quotes, payment methods, transaction state and errors.
Handle the realities of browser and mobile environments, including cross-origin communication, redirects, storage restrictions and application lifecycle events.
Develop consistent behaviour across web, iOS and Android integrations.
Ensure integrations remain secure when operating inside products MoonPay does not control.
Make complex systems easy to use
Design APIs and SDKs that are difficult to misuse and straightforward to debug.
Establish clear versioning, compatibility and migration strategies.
