title: Senior Manager, Partner Program Ecosystem Co-Sell
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The Senior Manager, Partner Program Ecosystem Co-Sell owns how Everpure rewards, funds and enables partners to co-sell joint solutions, and makes sure every dollar of partner investment returns measurable pipeline and revenue. You design and run the partner program and its investment model, build the value exchange with ecosystem partners (technology, cloud, GSI, distributor and reseller), and turn those partnerships into repeatable joint solution selling through a "Meet in the Channel" motion: meeting customers where they already buy, through and with partners.

This role can be staffed from the Santa Clara, New York, Chicago, or Durham offices.

What you will do

You are accountable for a partner program that is simple to join, rewards partners for co-selling, and returns more than it costs. The role covers program design and operations; alliance go-to-market and joint solution development sit with other teams.

Partner program and benefits design

• Design the global partner program framework supporting co-sell sales motion

• Design benefits that support an ecosystem of partners co-selling together, such as tier-based rebates, incentives, MDF, NFR, enablement, and co-marketing funds, and set clear eligibility for each.

• Evolve the program each year from partner feedback, field input, and performance data; retire benefits that do not change partner behavior.

• Run the program calendar, launches, and partner communications so partners and field teams know what changed and why.

Value exchange design

• Define the value exchange for each partner type: what Everpure invests and what the partner commits in return (certified people, pipeline, customer outcomes, co-sell participation).

• Build the partner investment model and own the budget with Finance; set guardrails, approval paths, and ROI thresholds for every funding mechanism.

• Track return on partner investment by partner, segment, and program, and move funding toward what produces sourced and influenced revenue.

• Structure program terms for strategic partners, including joint business plan templates that tie shared investment to shared targets.

Deal registration and co-sell protection

• Own the deal registration policy and process: eligibility, approval rules, expiration, renewal, and how multiple partners on one deal are treated.

• Define rules of engagement and conflict resolution with Sales and Channel leaders so partners trust that registered deals are protected.

• Set how registration, partner of record, and influence are credited for incentives, rebates, and tier status.

• Review registration data to find abuse, gaps, and slow approvals, and fix the process.

Meet in the Channel

• Define the program rules and benefits that let Everpure and partners meet customers in the channel: co-sell participation, named-account alignment, and credit for partner-led and distributor-led deals.

• Make the program work across routes to market, including distributors, resellers, and cloud marketplaces: fair incentives, no double payment, and clear fulfillment and quoting paths.

• Partner with Sales and Channel Operations on the field playbook for Meet in the Channel, and train field and partner teams on the rules.

• Collect partner and seller feedback and resolve program blockers that slow co-sell deals.

Governance, metrics, and operations

• Define and report program health: partner-sourced and influenced pipe

title: Manager, Technical and Global Accounting
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Accuracy, completeness, and control are the foundation of everything Accounting does at KAYAK. Our goal is to build on that foundation with a close that is faster, cleaner, and better understood every quarter, run by people who know what is driving the numbers and can explain it. Modernizing how accounting gets done is a strategic priority for KAYAK and for Controllership, and this role will help shape it.

KAYAK is seeking a Manager, Technical & Global Accounting to lead a broad portfolio of accounting areas across our global entities, including areas that call for significant technical judgment, and help ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial reporting. You will make and document accounting calls on complex transactions, own final review across your portfolio, and explain the story behind the numbers to senior leaders and auditors. You will set the standard for how your areas operate, and lead and develop a team of senior and staff accountants. You will own modernization within your area, translating Controllership priorities into execution of our automation roadmap and implementation of agentic workflows, in partnership with our systems and process teams.

You will partner with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Payroll, Operations, Product, and Technology, and bring an accounting perspective early, so decisions are made with the implications in view. The ideal candidate has sound judgment and is comfortable with ambiguity. They set direction, make the call when it needs to be made, and are committed to developing others. They are never satisfied with "that's how we've always done it."

This role will be required to work from our Norwalk, CT office at least 3 days per week.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

LEAD THE PORTFOLIO AND SET THE STANDARD

- Own a broad portfolio of accounting areas that call for significant technical judgment, including revenue, accounts receivable and credit loss reserves, capitalized software and technology costs, technology-related prepaids, and legal, marketing, and other accruals.

- Perform technical revenue review (complex contract reviews, quarterly technical deliverables, reconciliations). Form, document, and defend positions on complex or judgmental transactions, and decide what to escalate to the Director and when.

- Lead the monthly close across your portfolio and global entities by planning the calendar, setting review standards, and giving final sign-off on reconciliations, flux analysis, and commentary. Act as final reviewer in FloQast, ensuring reconciling items are supported, resolved on time, and audit-ready.

- Lead close and balance sheet review meetings and present quarterly pre-close materials to senior leadership and the broader finance team. Communicate risks, open items, decisions, and progress clearly and early to the Director and other stakeholders.

- Serve as a primary contact for external auditors and Booking Holdings reporting, and support quarterly and year-end requirements as accounting responsibilities globalize.

- Partner with Tax, Legal, FP&A, Payroll, Accounts Payable, Product, and Commercial on allocations, cross-charges, and complex transactions. Engage early on new products and arrangements so leaders understand the accounting implications

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

MAKE EVERYTHING JUST WORK

Most jobs ask you to keep the lights on. This one asks you to build the machine that keeps an entire company and its customers running.

At Reonic, we’re building the AI operating system for renewable installers, with competitive pay, growth opportunities and a strong culture based on ambition, impact and ownership. And we’re doing it fast.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’re where our product meets the real world. You work hands-on with renewable energy installers and their technical teams, help them build on our API, and solve the problems that stand between them and a setup that just works. Around 80% of your time is spent with customers. The other 20% goes to making Reonic itself run the way an AI-first company should.

With our customers (~80%)

- Enable our API users: Work with customers’ technical teams as they build on our API and webhooks. Review their approach, answer the tricky questions and get them unblocked fast.

- Solve problems end to end: When something breaks, you find out why. Reproduce the issue, work with engineering on the fix and keep the customer in the loop until it’s solved.

- Connect Reonic to their world: Make Reonic work seamlessly with the tools our customers rely on every day, from Microsoft and Google to their CRM, accounting and automation platforms.

- Make customers self-sufficient: Write guides, examples and snippets that help customers help themselves.

Inside Reonic (~20%)

- Run our AI tools: Own our Claude and ChatGPT workspaces, from access and connectors to costs.

- Make AI part of everyone’s job: Help colleagues build integrations, connectors and automations that save them real time.

- Own our IT setup: Keep our tools, devices and security running smoothly, so everyone at Reonic can do their best work from day one.

What makes you a great fit

- Technical understanding: You’re comfortable with APIs, webhooks and authentication flows such as OAuth, and you aren’t afraid to dig into the details.

- AI and automation enthusiasm: You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier or n8n every day and enjoy finding new ways to automate work.

- Microsoft 365 expertise: You have hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and you’re the person others turn to when something in the Microsoft world doesn’t work.

- Strong communication: Fluent German and C2 English proficiency are required.

- Nice to have: TypeScript knowledge, experience with Apple Mobile Device Management, and experience with any of the systems we integrate with, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Workspace, lexoffice or sevdesk.

You’ll thrive here if you…

- Can’t stand a broken process, and fix it before anyone else notices

- See a messy setup as a challenge, not a reason to complain

- Automate anything you’ve done twice

- Would rather get sh*t done than talk about getting it done

- Are the one friends and colleagues call when their tech doesn’t work

If you want a quiet IT job with a ticket queue, this isn’t it.
If you want to be the reason things run smoothly at a fast-growing company, you’ll love it.
